mapper.select: select lot_id, device_name, sum(seed_count) as seed_count, -- 种子数 sum(worked_area) as worked_area, -- 亩数 sum(sow_line) as sow_line, -- 行数 sum(sow_distance) as sow_distance, -- 距离 count(*) as sow_count, -- 播种次数 case when sum(worked_area) > 0 then sum(seed_count) * 15.0 / sum(worked_area) else 0 end as seed_count_hectare -- 每公顷种子数 from data_electric_seeder_message desm where desm.status != 1 and desm.data_time > #{startDate} and #{endDate} > desm.data_time and desm.upload_type = 1 group by lot_id, device_name;
